<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#00000040"/>
  <rect x="0" y="82" width="390" height="762" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="82" width="390" height="1" fill="#D6D6D6"/>
  <rect x="171" y="92" width="48" height="5" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="35" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">8:23</text>
  <rect x="320" y="24" width="6" height="10" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="328" y="21" width="6" height="13" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="336" y="18" width="6" height="16" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="27" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="348.2" y1="27" x2="348.2" y2="27" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="357" y="20" width="22" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="379" y="23.5" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="359" y="22" width="15" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Back arrow -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,120 24,130 34,140" fill="none" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="130" x2="39" y2="130" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="58" y="132" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#161C34">Create an account</text>
  <text x="58" y="156" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Join Expedia to save trips, track bookings, and get member prices.</text>

  <!-- Fields -->
  <text x="30" y="202" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Email address</text>
  <rect x="30" y="210" width="330" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#787981" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="44" y="240" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C34">anna.roberts@example.com</text>

  <text x="30" y="282" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">First name</text>
  <rect x="30" y="290" width="330" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#787981" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="44" y="320" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C34">Anna</text>

  <text x="30" y="362" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Last name</text>
  <rect x="30" y="370" width="330" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#787981" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="44" y="400" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C34">Roberts</text>

  <text x="30" y="442" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7B7D85">Password</text>
  <rect x="30" y="450" width="330" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="44" y="480" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#161C34">••••••••••••</text>

  <g>
    <circle cx="338" cy="474" r="11" fill="#F2F2F2" stroke="#D6D6D6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="474" r="3.3" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="481" x2="345" y2="467" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Strength meter -->
  <rect x="30" y="514" width="330" height="8" rx="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <rect x="30" y="514" width="292" height="8" rx="4" fill="#416D65"/>
  <text x="30" y="505" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#545667">Password Strength</text>
  <text x="320" y="505" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#416D65">Strong</text>

  <!-- Checklist -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="536" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="34,544 37,547.5 42,540.5" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="549" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">At least 8 characters</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="561" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="34,569 37,572.5 42,565.5" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="574" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">Capital and lowercase letters</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="586" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="34,594 37,597.5 42,590.5" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="599" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">A special character ~ #@$%&!*_?^-</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="611" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="34,619 37,622.5 42,615.5" fill="none" stroke="#416D65" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="624" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#416D65">A number</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Info note -->
  <rect x="30" y="637" width="330" height="60" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D7D8D5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="656" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="650" x2="46" y2="658" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="662" r="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
  <text x="66" y="654" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#161C34">Protect your account</text>
  <text x="66" y="671" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Avoid using spaces, your name, email, or passwords you’ve used before.</text>

  <!-- Opt-in checkbox -->
  <rect x="30" y="708" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#72747F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polyline points="34,716 37,719.5 42,712.5" fill="none" stroke="#4761C8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="54" y="721" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Send me travel deals, special offers, and Expedia Rewards updates.</text>

  <!-- Terms -->
  <text x="30" y="744" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">By continuing, you agree to Expedia</text>
  <text x="30" y="761" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Terms and conditions, Privacy Statement</text>
  <text x="296" y="761" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">and</text>
  <text x="30" y="778" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Expedia Rewards Terms and Conditions.</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="790" width="330" height="48" rx="8" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <text x="195" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom nav -->
  <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="784" x2="390" y2="784" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g transform="translate(28,796)">
    <polygon points="12,2 22,10 18,10 18,20 6,20 6,10 2,10" fill="#4761C8"/>
    <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4761C8">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(106,796)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="16.5" y1="14.5" x2="21" y2="19" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(182,796)">
    <rect x="6" y="5" width="12" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="6" y1="11" x2="18" y2="11" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(257,796)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="2" fill="#525467"/>
    <rect x="7" y="14" width="10" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#525467"/>
    <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Account</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(330,796)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="12" y1="6" x2="12" y2="14" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="10" x2="16" y2="10" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="12" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Deals</text>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle sheet shadow -->
  <rect x="0" y="84" width="390" height="2" fill="#00000014"/>
</svg>
